transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

For the past eight months, I've been feeling this overwhelming surge of energy and I just can't seem to sit still. My mood has been swinging wildly between feeling incredibly happy and getting extremely irritated at the smallest things. I really need some help managing this constant restlessness and these intense mood swings.
Have you had any periods where this elevated or irritable mood and extra energy lasted at least 4 days, or at least 1 week, and caused major problems at work, school, or in relationships?

Yes, I have. In fact, these intense periods of high energy and mood swings have been happening almost constantly for about eight months now. It has caused major problems in my daily life and relationships because I get irritated so easily and just can't slow down.
Have you ever had symptoms so severe that you needed to be hospitalized, or had hallucinations or delusional beliefs during these episodes?

I've never been hospitalized, but I definitely experience hallucinations and strange beliefs, though they only happen when my energy is really high. During those times, I've heard voices, seen things that aren't there, and even believed I had a special mission or was being watched. They completely go away once my mood settles down.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports a prolonged manic syndrome over about 8 months with markedly elevated/irritable mood, increased energy, restlessness, and major functional impairment. Psychotic symptoms (auditory/visual hallucinations and grandiose/paranoid delusions) occur only during the high-energy mood episodes and resolve when mood stabilizes, which supports bipolar I disorder with psychotic features rather than schizoaffective disorder or primary psychosis.
